name: Rallying Megaphone
text: When this card loses a trick, you may lead the next trick.
archetypes: Bonus Chaser, Spade Master, Contract Attacker, High Card
decision: Which trick to lose with this card: throw it under an opponent's winner when you hold aces to cash or a ruff to set up.
opponent: Visible on trigger; the trick winner keeps the trick but loses the lead.
aiNote: Play this card as a loser when you hold a top card to lead next; decline the lead when your partner won.
rationale: One chosen lead a round is worth about a quarter of a trick. Tying it to this card keeps it to about once a round and makes the decision which trick to lose with it.
deviation: Changed from a once-per-round option on any lost trick, which played as an activated ability, to a trigger on this card losing.
